newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed on Thursday in subdued activity, millfeed dealers said.
"Thin supplies in the (U.S.) Northeast are keeping prices firm," a Buffalo dealer said. He said demand was holding up from a lack of supply surplus.

In the Minneapolis area, flooding from the upper Mississippi prevented flour mills from securing or delivering supplies. "We can't get the product in or out," a dealer said, referring to closed rail lines and flooded roads.
One Missouri broker said nearby trades were spotty, but a North Carolina dealer noted a downward price trend.
"Maybe the run times have improved. It seems like the sellers are pushing to get something done. It feels like there are more ample nearby supplies," the North Carolina dealer said.
